item.title: THE CITY OF EKURHULENI IS CONDUCTING PUBLIC CONSULTATION MEETINGS ON THE ELECTRICITY TARIFF INCREASE APPLICATION FOR THE 2026/27 FINANCIAL YEAR - City of Ekurhuleni
item.description: The proposed electricity tariff changes for 2026/27 aim to simplify the tariff structure by moving Tariff A residential customers to a single, flat kilowatt hour rate, replacing the stepped pricing model. Other tariff structural changes are outlined in the presentation. The proposed average increase of 9.01% is in line with NERSA guidelines and national approvals. […]
